provenance: Hand-authored synthetic coding-memory regression fixtures, 2026-10-30. Labels written before the first run; not real session data or an independent held-out effectiveness benchmark.

memories.title: Cent settlement contract
memories.body: The payment processor rejects fractional minor units. Preserve two decimal places at the outbound boundary.

memories.title: Quarterly audit evidence
memories.body: Finance needs the original line items retained for seven years in the audit archive.

memories.title: Receipt prefix migration
memories.body: Keep the INV prefix until legacy accounting imports have been migrated.

memories.title: Freight carrier surcharge
memories.body: The carrier applies a three-unit rate per kilogram under the annual contract.

memories.title: Partner recovery window
memories.body: Our upstream's connection lease expires after one minute. The waiting period must never exceed that duration.

memories.title: Fleet synchronization follow-up
memories.body: Randomized scheduling is deferred until the gateway migration is finished. Identical schedules can otherwise amplify congestion.

memories.title: Operational logging policy
memories.body: Routine successful requests must not emit warning messages.

queries.question: What decisions should I consider before modifying retry_delay?

queries.question: When does our upstream connection lease expire?
queries.rationale: Only the partner recovery decision describes the lease duration.

queries.question: What does retry_delay(3) return?
queries.rationale: The answer is arithmetic from code; operational history is unnecessary.

queries.question: Why is retry_delay capped at 60?
queries.rationale: The lease explains the cap. Deferred randomization does not.

queries.rationale: The fixture contains no key rotation evidence.

memories.title: Customer isolation boundary
memories.body: Separate organizations may reuse object identifiers. Partition their entries to prevent one customer observing another customer's data.

memories.title: Delimiter migration
memories.body: Colon characters remain permitted in legacy identifiers. A length-prefixed representation is planned after the old clients retire.

memories.title: Freshness service agreement
memories.body: Inventory can lag behind the origin by at most five minutes.
